chapterInfo.content:
24
Nkanea no ngo
1Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: 2#Eks 27.20 Hyɛ Israelfoɔ ma wɔmmrɛ wo ngodua aba a wɔasie ngo korɔgyenn na wɔmfa nsɔ kanea no, na kanea no nsi so daa; 3adanseɛ ntwamutam no akyi, ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu na Aaron nsiesie mfiri anwummerɛ nkɔsi anɔpa, AWURADE anim daa; ɛyɛ daa ahyɛdeɛ ma mo awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa. 4Sika amapa kaneadua a ɛho teɛ no so na ɔnsiesie nkanea no, AWURADE anim daa.
Kyerɛ paanoo
5Na fa esiam to taterɛ dummienu; olonka abupɛn du mu mmienu nyɛ taterɛ baako. 6#Eks 25.30 Na fa sesɛ so akyerɛpɛn mmienu, nsia nyɛ kyerɛpɛn baako, ɛpono a ɛho teɛ no so, AWURADE anim. 7Na fa ohwamfufuo korɔgyenn toto akyerɛpɛn no so, na ɛnyɛ paanoo no so nkaeɛ adeɛ, ogya afɔdeɛ a wɔsɔ ma AWURADE. 8Daa homeda na ɔnsiesie wɔ AWURADE anim daa, ɛyɛ Israelfoɔ fam daa apam; 9na ɛnyɛ Aaron ne ne mma deɛ, na wɔnni wɔ deɛ ɛhɔ yɛ kronkron, ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ akronkronneɛ mu ade kronkron a ɛfiri AWURADE gya afɔdeɛ so ma no, ɛyɛ daa kyɛfa.
Mmusuo ho asotwe
10Na Israelni baa bi ba a n’agya yɛ Misraimni firii adi Israelfoɔ no mu, na Israelni baa no ba no ne Israelni bi hamee nsraban no mu. 11#Lew 24.16 Na Israelni baa no ba no kaa edin no ho abususɛm, na ɔdomee. Na wɔde no brɛɛ Mose. Nso ne na din de Selomit, Dibri ba a ɔfiri Dan abusuakuo mu; 12#Num 15.34 na wɔbɔɔ no dua mu sɛ ɛnkɔsi sɛ ɔbɛnya AWURADE anomu asɛm aka akyerɛ wɔn.
13Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: 14Fa deɛ wadome no firi adi kɔ nsraban no akyi, na wɔn a wɔteeɛ no nyinaa mfa wɔn nsa ngu n’atifi, na asafo no nyinaa nsi no aboɔ. 15Na kasa kyerɛ Israelfoɔ nso sɛ: Obiara a ɔbɛdome ne Nyankopɔn no, ɔbɛsoa ne bɔne. 16#Eks 20.7; Mat 26.65 Na deɛ ɔka AWURADE din ho abususɛm no, kum na wɔnku no: Sie na asafo no nyinaa nsi no aboɔ; ɔhɔhoɔ oo, kuromani oo, sɛ ɔka edin no ho abususɛm a, wɔnku no.
17 # Eks 21.12 Na sɛ obi kum onipa biara a, kum na wɔnku no.
18Na deɛ ɔkum afieboa no, ɔnsi ananmu, ɔkra nsi ɔkra ananmu. 19#Eks 21.23-25 Na deɛ ɔpira ne yɔnko nipa no, sɛdeɛ ɔyɛeɛ no, wɔnyɛ no saa ara: 20Ebuo nsi ebuo ananmu, ani nsi ani ananmu, ɛse nsi ɛse ananmu; sɛdeɛ ɔpiraa onipa no, saa ara na wɔnyɛ no. 21Na deɛ ɔkum afieboa no, ɔnsi ananmu, na deɛ ɔkum onipa no, wɔnku no. 22#Lew 19.34; Eks 12.49 Atemmuo koro nna hɔ mma mo, ɔhɔhoɔ nyɛ sɛ okuromani. Na mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn.
23 # Num 15.36 Na Mose kasa kyerɛɛ Israelfoɔ, na wɔde deɛ ɔdomeeɛ no firii adi kɔɔ nsraban no akyi kɔsii no aboɔ. Na Israelfoɔ yɛɛ sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Hyɛ Israelfoɔ ma wɔmmrɛ wo ngodua aba a wɔasie ngo korɔgyenn na wɔmfa nsɔ kanea no, na kanea no nsi so daa; adanseɛ ntwamutam no akyi, ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu na Aaron nsiesie mfiri anwummerɛ nkɔsi anɔpa, AWURADE anim daa; ɛyɛ daa ahyɛdeɛ ma mo awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa. Sika amapa kaneadua a ɛho teɛ no so na ɔnsiesie nkanea no, AWURADE anim daa.

Na fa esiam to taterɛ dummienu; olonka abupɛn du mu mmienu nyɛ taterɛ baako. Na fa sesɛ so akyerɛpɛn mmienu, nsia nyɛ kyerɛpɛn baako, ɛpono a ɛho teɛ no so, AWURADE anim. Na fa ohwamfufuo korɔgyenn toto akyerɛpɛn no so, na ɛnyɛ paanoo no so nkaeɛ adeɛ, ogya afɔdeɛ a wɔsɔ ma AWURADE. Daa homeda na ɔnsiesie wɔ AWURADE anim daa, ɛyɛ Israelfoɔ fam daa apam; na ɛnyɛ Aaron ne ne mma deɛ, na wɔnni wɔ deɛ ɛhɔ yɛ kronkron, ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ akronkronneɛ mu ade kronkron a ɛfiri AWURADE gya afɔdeɛ so ma no, ɛyɛ daa kyɛfa.

Na Israelni baa bi ba a n’agya yɛ Misraimni firii adi Israelfoɔ no mu, na Israelni baa no ba no ne Israelni bi hamee nsraban no mu. Na Israelni baa no ba no kaa edin no ho abususɛm, na ɔdomee. Na wɔde no brɛɛ Mose. Nso ne na din de Selomit, Dibri ba a ɔfiri Dan abusuakuo mu; na wɔbɔɔ no dua mu sɛ ɛnkɔsi sɛ ɔbɛnya AWURADE anomu asɛm aka akyerɛ wɔn.
Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Fa deɛ wadome no firi adi kɔ nsraban no akyi, na wɔn a wɔteeɛ no nyinaa mfa wɔn nsa ngu n’atifi, na asafo no nyinaa nsi no aboɔ. Na kasa kyerɛ Israelfoɔ nso sɛ: Obiara a ɔbɛdome ne Nyankopɔn no, ɔbɛsoa ne bɔne. Na deɛ ɔka AWURADE din ho abususɛm no, kum na wɔnku no: Sie na asafo no nyinaa nsi no aboɔ; ɔhɔhoɔ oo, kuromani oo, sɛ ɔka edin no ho abususɛm a, wɔnku no.
Na sɛ obi kum onipa biara a, kum na wɔnku no.
Na deɛ ɔkum afieboa no, ɔnsi ananmu, ɔkra nsi ɔkra ananmu. Na deɛ ɔpira ne yɔnko nipa no, sɛdeɛ ɔyɛeɛ no, wɔnyɛ no saa ara: Ebuo nsi ebuo ananmu, ani nsi ani ananmu, ɛse nsi ɛse ananmu; sɛdeɛ ɔpiraa onipa no, saa ara na wɔnyɛ no. Na deɛ ɔkum afieboa no, ɔnsi ananmu, na deɛ ɔkum onipa no, wɔnku no. Atemmuo koro nna hɔ mma mo, ɔhɔhoɔ nyɛ sɛ okuromani. Na mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn.
Na Mose kasa kyerɛɛ Israelfoɔ, na wɔde deɛ ɔdomeeɛ no firii adi kɔɔ nsraban no akyi kɔsii no aboɔ. Na Israelfoɔ yɛɛ sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
